description: Returns one documentation page as Markdown, with absolute links. Screenshots appear as images whose alt text describes them; the numbered list after a screenshot explains its numbered markers. Accepts a URL or path from search_docs or list_pages (e.g. "/lt/docs/guide/browsing-data/table"), or a slug such as "guide/browsing-data/table".

lang.description: "lt" or "en". Overrides the language in the path; defaults to the path's language, else English.

page.description: Page URL, site path or slug.

name: get_page
title: Read a documentation page
